name: color-token-card
title: Color token card
description: A design colour documented: swatch, name and token, a value that copies as hex, rgb or oklch, and its contrast on white and black with pass marks.
docs: name, value, token and usage describe the colour. value may be hex ('#0A7D5C'), rgb ('rgb(10 125 92)') or oklch ('oklch(0.55 0.115 169)'), with or without alpha, and is read in the browser. The card starts on the format the value is written in, and keeps its digits when that format is showing; one button cycles through copyFormats (hex, rgb, oklch by default) and the other copies what is showing, with the result said politely (onCopied is called with the text and its format). Contrast against white and black is worked out with the WCAG 2 formula on the 8-bit values (a colour with alpha is laid over each background first), and each result is a grade in words with a glyph: AAA with a double check, AA with a check, 'AA large' with a warning for large text only, Fail with a cross. A screen reader hears one sentence per result ('4.8:1 on white, AA: meets AA for text of any size'). A value that is not hex, rgb or oklch is shown as written and gets no contrast. Put the cards in a grid for a palette page. labels carries every word and locale writes the numbers.
